chapterInfo.content:
11
Petro bɔ amanneɛ kyerɛ Yerusalem asɔre no
1Na asomafoɔ ne anuanom a wɔwɔ Yudea no tee sɛ amanaman mufoɔ no nso agye Nyankopɔn asɛm. 2#Aso 10.45 Na Petro baa Yerusalem no, wɔn a wɔyɛ twetiatwafoɔ no ne no gyee akyinnyeɛ 3#Gal 2.12 sɛ: Adɛn nti na woakɔ nnipa a wɔnyɛ twetiatwafoɔ mu, na wo ne wɔn akɔdidie yi? 4Na Petro firii aseɛ bɔɔ wɔn ne nyinaa ho amanneɛ mmaako mmaako sɛ: 5#Aso 10.9-48 Mewɔ Yopa kuro mu merebɔ mpaeɛ, na m’ani wiaa me maa mekɔɔ tebea foforɔ mu, na anisoadehunu mu no, mehunuu biribi a ɛresiane sɛ nwera kɛseɛ a wɔakyekyere no ahinanan, na wɔgyaa mu firi soro, na ɛbaa me nkyɛn. 6Na megyenee m’ani mehwɛɛ mu no, mehunuu asase so ntɔteboa ne anwonanwonammoa ne wɔn a wɔwea ne wiem ntakraboa wɔ mu. 7Na metee sɛ ɛnne bi ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Petro, sɔre kum di! 8Na mese: Dabi da, Awurade, ɛfiri sɛ biribiara a wɔkyire, anaa ɛho nteɛ nkɔɔ m’anomu da. 9Na ɛnne no firi soro buaa me ne mprenu so sɛ: Deɛ Onyankopɔn ate ho no, mmu no akyiwadeɛ. 10Yei yɛɛ mprɛnsa, na wɔtwetwee ne nyinaa kɔɔ soro bio.
11Na amonom hɔ ara na nnipa baasa a wɔsomaa wɔn firi Kaesarea baa me nkyɛn no gyina efie a mewɔ mu no ano. 12Na Honhom no ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ me ne wɔn nkɔ, na mennye hwee ho akyinnyeɛ. Nso anuanom baasia yi ne me kɔe, na yɛkɔɔ ɔbarima no fie. 13Na ɔkaa yɛn sɛdeɛ ɔhunuu ɔbɔfoɔ sɛ ɔgyina ne fie hɔ, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Soma nnipa kɔ Yopa kɔhyia Simon a wɔfrɛ no Petro. 14Ɔno na ɔbɛka nsɛm a wo ne wo fie nyinaa nam so bɛnya nkwagyeɛ akyerɛ woɔ. 15Na mefirii aseɛ sɛ merekasa no, Honhom Kronkron bɛguu wɔn so, sɛdeɛ mfitiaseɛ no, ɛbɛguu yɛn so no ara. 16#Aso 1.5 Na mekaee Awurade asɛm a ɔkaa sɛ: Yohane de nsuo na ɛbɔɔ asu, na mo deɛ, wɔde Honhom Kronkron na ɛbɛbɔ mo asu. 17Enti sɛ Onyankopɔn maa wɔn akyɛdeɛ korɔ no ara sɛ yɛn nso a yɛgyee Awurade Yesu Kristo diiɛ no a, mene hwan a mɛtumi masi Onyankopɔn kwan? 18Na wɔtee nsɛm yi no, wɔmuaa wɔn ano, na wɔyii Onyankopɔn ayɛ sɛ: Ɛnneɛ na Onyankopɔn ama amanaman mufoɔ no nso adwensakyera a ɛde kɔ nkwa mu.
Amanaman mu asafo a ɛdi kan
19 # Aso 8.1-4 Afei wɔn a ɔhaw a ɛsɔree Stefano soɔ no nti wɔhweteeɛ no kyinii kɔduruu Foinike ne Kipro ne Antiokia, na wɔanka asɛm no ankyerɛ obiara sɛ Yudafoɔ nko. 20Na wɔn mu binom nso a wɔyɛ Kiprofoɔ ne Kirenefoɔ baa Antiokia no, wɔkasa kaa Awurade Yesu ho asɛmpa kyerɛɛ Helafoɔ no. 21#Aso 2.47 Na Awurade nsa ka wɔn ho, na nnipa pii gye dii, na wɔdane baa Awurade nkyɛn.
Barnaba kɔ Antiokia
22 # Aso 4.36 Na wɔn ho asɛm yi duruu asafo a ɛwɔ Yerusalem no aso mu, na wɔsomaa Barnaba sɛ ɔnkɔ ara nkɔduru Antiokia. 23#Aso 13.43 Na ɔbaeɛ na ɔbɛhunuu Nyankopɔn adom no, n’ani gyee, na ɔtuu wɔn nyinaa fo sɛ wɔnsi wɔn adwene pi mmata Awurade ho. 24#Aso 6.5; 5.14 Na ɔyɛ onipa pa a Honhom Kronkron ne gyidie ahyɛ no ma. Na wɔde nkurɔfoɔ bebree bɛkaa Awurade ho.
25 # Aso 9.30; Gal 2.11 Na ɔfiri hɔ kɔɔ Tarso kɔhwehwɛɛ Saulo; 26na ɔhunuu no no, ɔde no baa Antiokia. Na wɔne asafo no bɛtenae afirinhyia mu, na wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ nkurɔfoɔ bebree. Antiokia na wɔdii kan too asuafoɔ no din Kristofoɔ.
Wɔboa Yudea Kristofoɔ ahiafoɔ
27 # Aso 13.1; 15.32 Na nna no mu no, adiyifoɔ bi firi Yerusalem baa Antiokia. 28#Aso 21.10 Na wɔn mu baako a ne din de Agabo sɔree nam Honhom so kyerɛɛ sɛ ɛkɔm kɛseɛ rebɛba asase nyinaa so; ɛno na ɛbaa mu Klaudio berɛ soɔ no. 29#Gal 2.10 Na asuafoɔ no bɔɔ wɔn tirim sɛ wɔn nyinaa mmaako mmaako de biribi bɛmane anuanom a wɔte Yudea no, sɛdeɛ wɔn mu biara bɛtumi, na wɔde ahwɛ wɔn. 30#Aso 12.25 Wɔyɛɛ saa, na wɔde somaa Barnaba ne Saulo maa wɔde kɔmaa mpanimfoɔ no.

Na asomafoɔ ne anuanom a wɔwɔ Yudea no tee sɛ amanaman mufoɔ no nso agye Nyankopɔn asɛm. Na Petro baa Yerusalem no, wɔn a wɔyɛ twetiatwafoɔ no ne no gyee akyinnyeɛ sɛ: Adɛn nti na woakɔ nnipa a wɔnyɛ twetiatwafoɔ mu, na wo ne wɔn akɔdidie yi? Na Petro firii aseɛ bɔɔ wɔn ne nyinaa ho amanneɛ mmaako mmaako sɛ: Mewɔ Yopa kuro mu merebɔ mpaeɛ, na m’ani wiaa me maa mekɔɔ tebea foforɔ mu, na anisoadehunu mu no, mehunuu biribi a ɛresiane sɛ nwera kɛseɛ a wɔakyekyere no ahinanan, na wɔgyaa mu firi soro, na ɛbaa me nkyɛn. Na megyenee m’ani mehwɛɛ mu no, mehunuu asase so ntɔteboa ne anwonanwonammoa ne wɔn a wɔwea ne wiem ntakraboa wɔ mu. Na metee sɛ ɛnne bi ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Petro, sɔre kum di! Na mese: Dabi da, Awurade, ɛfiri sɛ biribiara a wɔkyire, anaa ɛho nteɛ nkɔɔ m’anomu da. Na ɛnne no firi soro buaa me ne mprenu so sɛ: Deɛ Onyankopɔn ate ho no, mmu no akyiwadeɛ. Yei yɛɛ mprɛnsa, na wɔtwetwee ne nyinaa kɔɔ soro bio.
Na amonom hɔ ara na nnipa baasa a wɔsomaa wɔn firi Kaesarea baa me nkyɛn no gyina efie a mewɔ mu no ano. Na Honhom no ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ me ne wɔn nkɔ, na mennye hwee ho akyinnyeɛ. Nso anuanom baasia yi ne me kɔe, na yɛkɔɔ ɔbarima no fie. Na ɔkaa yɛn sɛdeɛ ɔhunuu ɔbɔfoɔ sɛ ɔgyina ne fie hɔ, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Soma nnipa kɔ Yopa kɔhyia Simon a wɔfrɛ no Petro. Ɔno na ɔbɛka nsɛm a wo ne wo fie nyinaa nam so bɛnya nkwagyeɛ akyerɛ woɔ. Na mefirii aseɛ sɛ merekasa no, Honhom Kronkron bɛguu wɔn so, sɛdeɛ mfitiaseɛ no, ɛbɛguu yɛn so no ara. Na mekaee Awurade asɛm a ɔkaa sɛ: Yohane de nsuo na ɛbɔɔ asu, na mo deɛ, wɔde Honhom Kronkron na ɛbɛbɔ mo asu. Enti sɛ Onyankopɔn maa wɔn akyɛdeɛ korɔ no ara sɛ yɛn nso a yɛgyee Awurade Yesu Kristo diiɛ no a, mene hwan a mɛtumi masi Onyankopɔn kwan? Na wɔtee nsɛm yi no, wɔmuaa wɔn ano, na wɔyii Onyankopɔn ayɛ sɛ: Ɛnneɛ na Onyankopɔn ama amanaman mufoɔ no nso adwensakyera a ɛde kɔ nkwa mu.

Afei wɔn a ɔhaw a ɛsɔree Stefano soɔ no nti wɔhweteeɛ no kyinii kɔduruu Foinike ne Kipro ne Antiokia, na wɔanka asɛm no ankyerɛ obiara sɛ Yudafoɔ nko. Na wɔn mu binom nso a wɔyɛ Kiprofoɔ ne Kirenefoɔ baa Antiokia no, wɔkasa kaa Awurade Yesu ho asɛmpa kyerɛɛ Helafoɔ no. Na Awurade nsa ka wɔn ho, na nnipa pii gye dii, na wɔdane baa Awurade nkyɛn.

Na wɔn ho asɛm yi duruu asafo a ɛwɔ Yerusalem no aso mu, na wɔsomaa Barnaba sɛ ɔnkɔ ara nkɔduru Antiokia. Na ɔbaeɛ na ɔbɛhunuu Nyankopɔn adom no, n’ani gyee, na ɔtuu wɔn nyinaa fo sɛ wɔnsi wɔn adwene pi mmata Awurade ho. Na ɔyɛ onipa pa a Honhom Kronkron ne gyidie ahyɛ no ma. Na wɔde nkurɔfoɔ bebree bɛkaa Awurade ho.
Na ɔfiri hɔ kɔɔ Tarso kɔhwehwɛɛ Saulo; na ɔhunuu no no, ɔde no baa Antiokia. Na wɔne asafo no bɛtenae afirinhyia mu, na wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ nkurɔfoɔ bebree. Antiokia na wɔdii kan too asuafoɔ no din Kristofoɔ.

Na nna no mu no, adiyifoɔ bi firi Yerusalem baa Antiokia. Na wɔn mu baako a ne din de Agabo sɔree nam Honhom so kyerɛɛ sɛ ɛkɔm kɛseɛ rebɛba asase nyinaa so; ɛno na ɛbaa mu Klaudio berɛ soɔ no. Na asuafoɔ no bɔɔ wɔn tirim sɛ wɔn nyinaa mmaako mmaako de biribi bɛmane anuanom a wɔte Yudea no, sɛdeɛ wɔn mu biara bɛtumi, na wɔde ahwɛ wɔn. Wɔyɛɛ saa, na wɔde somaa Barnaba ne Saulo maa wɔde kɔmaa mpanimfoɔ no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
